## Read in Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(tidycensus)
library(scales)
```

## Read in data

```{r}
SAM <- st_read(here("oahu_solar_dedup_simple.geojson"))
```

## Map the data

```{r}
mapview(SAM)
```

## Retrieve census data

```{r}
library(tidycensus)

oahu_median_household_income <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variable = "B19013_001",
  state = "HI",
  county = "Honolulu",
  geometry = TRUE,
  year = 2022)

```

```{r}
mapview(oahu_median_household_income,
        zcol = "estimate")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = oahu_median_household_income,
       aes(x = moe, y = estimate)) + 
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

## Homework

```{r}
income_sf <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = "B19013_001",   # median household income
  state     = "HI",
  county    = "Honolulu",
  year      = 2022,
  geometry  = TRUE,
  survey    = "acs5"
) %>%
  rename(median_income = estimate, income_moe = moe) %>%
  filter(!is.na(median_income))   # drop tracts with no ACS estimate (e.g. no pop.)
```

```{r}
solar_sf <- st_read("oahu_solar_dedup_simple.geojson", quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r}
target_crs <- 3563

income_sf <- st_transform(income_sf, target_crs)
solar_sf  <- st_transform(solar_sf,  target_crs)

# Fix any invalid geometries before intersecting (common with dedup'd SAM
# detections and TIGER tract polygons alike).
income_sf <- st_make_valid(income_sf)
solar_sf  <- st_make_valid(solar_sf)
```

```{r}
solar_by_tract <- st_intersection(
  solar_sf,
  st_geometry(income_sf) %>% st_sf(GEOID = income_sf$GEOID, geometry = .)
) %>%
  mutate(solar_area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(
    solar_area_m2   = sum(solar_area_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_solar_polygons = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
tract_area <- income_sf %>%
  mutate(tract_area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(GEOID, tract_area_m2)

analysis_sf <- income_sf %>%
  left_join(solar_by_tract, by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(tract_area, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(
    solar_area_m2    = coalesce(solar_area_m2, 0),
    n_solar_polygons = coalesce(n_solar_polygons, 0),
    # solar coverage as a % of tract land area — the key normalized metric,
    # since raw solar_area_m2 is confounded by tract size
    solar_pct_cover  = 100 * solar_area_m2 / tract_area_m2,
    income_k         = median_income / 1000
  )
```

```{r}
cor_pearson  <- cor.test(analysis_sf$median_income, analysis_sf$solar_pct_cover,
                         method = "pearson")
cor_spearman <- cor.test(analysis_sf$median_income, analysis_sf$solar_pct_cover,
                         method = "spearman")

lm_fit <- lm(solar_pct_cover ~ median_income, data = analysis_sf)
lm_summary <- summary(lm_fit)

cat("Pearson r  =", round(cor_pearson$estimate, 3),
    " (p =", signif(cor_pearson$p.value, 3), ")\n")
cat("Spearman rho =", round(cor_spearman$estimate, 3),
    " (p =", signif(cor_spearman$p.value, 3), ")\n")
cat("R-squared (linear) =", round(lm_summary$r.squared, 3), "\n")

```

```{r}
map_income <- ggplot(analysis_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = income_k), color = "white", linewidth = 0.05) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Median\nincome ($k)",
                       labels = label_number(suffix = "k")) +
  labs(title = "Median household income") +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

map_solar <- ggplot(analysis_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = solar_pct_cover), color = "white", linewidth = 0.05) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Solar\ncoverage (%)") +
  labs(title = "Solar panel coverage") +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

combined_maps <- map_income + map_solar +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Median Income vs. Solar Panel Coverage — Oahu Census Tracts",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5))
  )
combined_maps

```
